values.note: ResNexus, read 2026-10-22, Tue 2027-05-11, 2 guests: Trout Run pull-through full hookup 30/50-amp $30; River Campsite #2 (tents and units under 29 ft) $30; River Campsites #4 and #6 (riverside, 50-amp full hookup) $35; tent/pop-up Riverside Escape sites with electric $30; camping cabins $45-69. Sat 2027-07-17 showed every unit occupied, so no weekend price was read.

hookups.source: https://www.attheridge.com/rv-sites ('Sites are full hookup with water, electric, and sewer servicing 30 & 50 amp.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: '14 roomy tent/RV sites' plus 7 cabins; premium sites on the river, regular sites inland. ResNexus sells 6 campsites online (River #2, #4, #6, Trout Run 1, two tent/pop-up Riverside Escape sites); River #2 is for 'units less than 29''.

sites.source: https://www.attheridge.com/ ('Enjoy 7 cozy cabins, 14 roomy tent/RV sites, and two bathhouses') + https://www.attheridge.com/rv-sites + ResNexus ('Trout Run Campsite 1 Pull thru full hook up site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Two bathhouses. Tent loop has no water or electric.

facilities.source: https://www.attheridge.com/ ('two bathhouses') + https://www.attheridge.com/tent-sites ('There is a bathhouse on the grounds with bathrooms and a shower'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Book Now' goes to the operator's ResNexus page; group rates by phone (828-877-2267). Max 8 people and 2 pets per RV site.

booking.source: https://www.attheridge.com/ (Book Now link) + https://www.attheridge.com/rv-sites ('Max 8 people & 2 Pets') + https://www.attheridge.com/tent-sites (group rates), read 2026-10-22

note: Small mountain campground on the North Fork of the French Broad River off NC 215 in Pisgah National Forest, ~7 mi from the Blue Ridge Parkway; riverside premium sites, inland regular sites, camping cabins and trout aquaculture runs on site. Big rigs OK; pool. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups and 14 tent/RV sites; added fees $30-35 (ResNexus quote for a May 2027 Tuesday), a pull-through, bathhouse showers, ResNexus booking. Note cleaned of hookups, site count, wifi and season. Not stated: season (year-round, derived, left), Wi-Fi (left), max rig length.
